description:
I'm a Computer Science Engineering student passionate about space exploration, simulation technology, and AI-powered applications. I'm currently developing Sol Mission Simulator, an interactive space mission simulator designed to let users plan missions, make spacecraft engineering decisions, manage resources, and explore the consequences of their choices.

I want to build more than a visually impressive simulation—I want to create an engaging educational game that makes complex space engineering concepts easier to understand through hands-on experimentation.

I'm looking for motivated teammates who are excited about space, science, and problem-solving. In particular, I'd love to collaborate with people who have skills or interests in:
• Web development and JavaScript/TypeScript
• Three.js, 3D graphics, and interactive simulations
• Astronomy, orbital mechanics, aerospace engineering, or physics
• Game design, UI/UX, and visual storytelling
• AI, scientific research, testing, and technical writing

You don't need to be an expert in everything. Curiosity, teamwork, creativity, and a willingness to learn are just as important. If you'd like to help turn an ambitious space mission game into a functional, engaging, and educational experience, I'd be happy to connect!
